entities.name: Discovery of Argoth
entities.description: Event in 55 AR when Harbin landed on Argoth.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Twenty-six-year-old son of Urza whose ornithopter landed on Argoth.

entities.name: Gwenna
entities.description: Argothian who spotted Harbin and spared him by substituting a dead sapling.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: Her law required sending word to Citanul.

entities.name: Citanul
entities.description: Place from which an elder would come.

events.summary: A storm drove Harbin's ornithopter from Korlis out to sea, and he crash-landed on Argoth.
events.quote: He landed roughly on the beach of Argoth and collapsed.

events.summary: Gwenna spotted Harbin and his craft.
events.quote: He and his craft were spotted by Gwenna

events.summary: Gwenna replaced the marked sapling with a dead one so Harbin would not cut a living tree and be killed.
events.quote: So she found a dead sapling of similar size and type and pulled it into the clearing

events.summary: Harbin repaired the thopter and left; Gwenna told the elder he had killed no trees.
events.quote: Gwenna told them that Harbin had not killed any trees before he escaped

relations.quote: Gwenna knew that if he cut the tree down, he would be killed by the Argothians
